decisions: GEO/AEO audit and fix system chosen after scoring six US opportunities; GEO scored 27/30 on demand, willingness to pay, competition, deliverability and evidence.
Scope is the audit and fix pack, not live AI querying or rank tracking, so the product is deterministic, offline and works with any tracker the buyer already uses.
40 weighted checks across 8 classes total 100 points; any critical finding forces DO NOT SHIP and any high finding blocks PASS.

llms.txt is explicitly positioned as optional agent readability, not a visibility lever, based on 2026 crawler evidence.
US pricing is $149 Solo / $299 Pro / $599 Agency with a $99 launch tier for the first 100 Solo buyers.
